messages:
Leah (Design): Quick sync: invite modal layout feedback from last review. main pain: roles matrix pushes primary action off-screen on small laptop.
Omar (PM): Saw 2 customer reports about not finding the audit link after SSO toggles changed.
Nora (Frontend): If we keep the roles grid, we can convert it to a horizontal scroller on narrow viewports so actions stay visible.
Eli (Accessibility): Horizontal scrollers can be problematic for keyboard users. If we do a scroller, ensure arrow-key focus and proper `aria-label` on the region.
Leah (Design): Alternative: collapse role details into a disclosure per row, showing just role name + badge count. expands inline. keeps primary CTA visible.
figma-bot: Figma update by Leah: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/invite-modal-layout (comment: collapsed-rows)
Sam (Support): For clarity, error copy needs to show reasons: e.g., "Invite blocked: org policy prevents this domain" rather than vague errors. Customers escalate on that.
Omar (PM): Agree. Also, SSO toggle placement: propose moving it above email input with microcopy "Require SSO to accept" and a help link to audit docs.
Leah (Design): I'll mock that. Also thinking of adding a small persistent audit link icon next to "Invite members" header so it's always 1 click away.
Nora (Frontend): Header icon is easy. We'll need to manage focus when drawer opens. ensure `aria-hidden` on background content.
Eli (Accessibility): When drawer opens, focus should move into the drawer and trap there. closing should return focus to the audit icon. Also check color contrast on the badge states (low contrast on light/dim).
Leah (Design): Noted. I'll increase contrast and add visible focus outlines. copy tweak: change "SSO invites" --> "Require SSO sign-in".
Omar (PM): Good. Let's gate the new layout behind a feature flag and run internal A/B for two weeks to watch invite completion and support volume.
Sam (Support): Please add a short note for support playbook if behavior changes for blocked domains.
Nora (Frontend): Estimate: 3 dev days for collapsed rows + 1 day for drawer + 1 day for tests/qa.
Leah (Design): I'll upload updated frames by tomorrow morning and tag this thread.
Eli (Accessibility): Happy to run a quick NVDA pass once the build hits staging.
Omar (PM): Thanks all. Quick action items: Leah update Figma, Nora rough estimate tracked in JIRA, Sam update support note, Eli will schedule accessibility pass.
Leah (Design): On it. Thanks! :sparkles:
